description: Audio analyzer – transcribes and extracts insights, entities, anomalies, and classification from audio files (WAV, MP3, OGG, FLAC, etc.)

Description.description: A comprehensive description of the overall audio content and context

TranscriptSummary.description: A high-level summary of the full audio transcript

KeyPhrases.description: Key phrases extracted from the audio transcript

NamedEntities.description: Named entities (people, places, organizations, dates) identified in the audio

Text.description: The entity text as it appears in the transcript

Category.description: Entity category (Person, Location, Organization, DateTime, Product, Event)

PiiData.description: Personally identifiable information detected in the audio (names, phone numbers, account numbers)

TimeLocation.description: Timestamp or time range where the PII occurs (e.g. 00:01:23 or 00:01:23-00:01:45)

AnyAnomaly.description: Anomalies detected in the audio (unusual speech patterns, background sounds, tampering indicators)

TimeLocation.description: Timestamp or time range where the anomaly occurs (e.g. 00:03:10 or 00:03:10-00:03:25)

Classification.description: Hierarchical classification of the audio content (up to 3 levels deep)

Category.description: Top-level category of the audio content (e.g. CustomerService, Meeting, Broadcast)

Subcategory.description: Second-level classification within the category (e.g. SupportCall, BoardMeeting, NewsReport)

Tag.description: Third-level specific tag within the subcategory (e.g. Escalation, QuarterlyReview, BreakingNews)
